name: coco2017_val5k_sd3m_seeded_v1
selection: 5,000 unique image IDs, one deterministic caption per image

pairing.rule: same prompt, evaluation_seed, and exact CPU float32 initial latent
pairing.latent_hash: SHA256 of contiguous CPU float32 bytes before device/dtype cast
pairing.note: This is a distinct SD3M protocol. It must not reuse or be merged with the PixArt 4x64x64 latent bank.

metrics: CleanFID clean mode against official COCO2017 val5K
extended_metric_failure_policy: isolated subprocess per metric; preserve partial results
status: code contract only; no SD3M generation or metric experiment has been run
